title: Hearty Shattering Italian Perilla-seed-deulkkae Frittata
description: A yeasty, shattering Italian dish featuring perilla-seed-deulkkae, perfect for adventurous eaters. This frittata is fodmap-friendly and cooked in a cataplana vessel.
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter in a cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped fresh parsley, basil, and bread crumbs, cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, Parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the cataplana vessel, cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges start to set.
Transfer the cataplana vessel to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown.
Remove the cataplana vessel from the oven and let it cool for 2-3 minutes.
Loosen the frittata from the cataplana vessel with a spatula and slide it onto a plate.
Cut the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese, if desired.
